title: Eccentric gym + easy spin
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: box step-downs 4x10/leg 4s lowering; single-leg decline squat 3x8/leg; Copenhagen plank 3x30s/side; single-leg calf raise 3x15. Then 30min easy spin.
GYM: this IS the gym session.
FUEL: protein within an hour.
STOP RULE: stop the step-downs at any lateral knee pain, not soreness.
WHY: this replaces downhill running as the guaranteed weekly eccentric stimulus. Mountain descents are a bonus, not the plan.
